rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent massing idea across all four views: a compact terraced block with a carved central court/void and a clear upper step sequence. The green parcel is respected by the dominant figure, and the blue access edge is answered by a legible ground opening/void rather than a sealed frontage. The silhouette is not just repetitive stair-stepping; the stepping appears to organize a single capacity-bearing form with hierarchy from heavier base to lighter upper retreat. In program terms, it plausibly supports neighborhood living because it offers an active threshold, one public void, and a calm upper massing, without drifting into a tower or large-span typology. The section is adequate for the brief even though it is not especially expressive of roof/daylight beyond the terrace logic.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more pavilion-like and sculptural; candidate is more linear/terraced and less airy.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise massing with a central void and a connective upper element can create a legible public threshold without losing compactness.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is a larger multi-building complex; candidate should not over-fragment into separate blocks.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A campus-like arrangement around a central open space can support neighborhood program when the ground plane remains public and connected.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference relies on a more explicitly civic frontage and glazed edge than the candidate shows.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A recessed court/void under an upper mass can turn a boxy volume into a legible civic threshold at ground level.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more openly transparent and elongated; candidate is more opaque and stepped.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Strong horizontal spread with a central atrium and folded roof logic can preserve openness while remaining capacity-aware.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference uses more pronounced circulation/bridge gestures; candidate’s court is more compact and enclosed.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced, connected wings around a core can express neighborhood hierarchy while keeping a calm upper silhouette.
